purpose: Define which meeting/regime variables can be used in the next historical validation without inventing PRE fields or selecting variables from favorable outcomes.
evidence_sources: Existing frozen B1a PREDICTION_LOCK inputs from the four historical 100-race batches.
Public Kdreams historical race-detail pages used only for source-semantic verification of race type/event grade/day labels.

field_size.source: count of successfully frozen active entrants

entrant_style_counts.source: frozen entrant style labels 逃/追/両

model_normalized_entropy.source: frozen B1a probabilities, computed before outcome scoring

model_top1_margin.source: difference between highest and second-highest frozen B1a probabilities

exact_circumference.source: authoritatively mapped venue circumference; exact value retained

evidence_examples: Kdreams historical race detail exposes labels such as A級特選, A級準決勝, S級特選 and A級決勝 in the race heading.
The same page exposes event grade/name such as F1 and meeting day labels such as 初日/2日目/最終日.
race_type_raw.rule: If a parser is added, freeze its exact lexical classification before target result scoring. Unknown labels become UNKNOWN/OTHER and must not cause race deletion.

event_grade_raw.rule: Preserve the raw observed grade label; do not infer a missing grade.

line_structure.reason: The current canonical historical B1a input lock does not contain authoritative line membership/order, and semantic extraction has not yet been independently verified. Style labels must not be treated as a substitute for line structure.

solo_rider.reason: Depends on authoritative line structure; cannot be inferred from style alone.

anti_leak_rules: No result, winner, payout or odds field is used to construct regime variables.
Any parser addition must be frozen before dedicated target result scoring.
A missing subgroup field never permits post-result race deletion; overall scoring retains the race and subgroup value is UNKNOWN.
Regime variables are explanatory/falsification dimensions, not permission to retune B1a inside the validation set.
